title: Geometric composition for the recursive Frobenius-power comparison
statement: Let k be a finite field, l a prime, and X a k-scheme. On the geometric fibre write g for the geometric Galois Frobenius and F_n=((g^n).inv)_* and G=(g.inv)_*. Write q_n:F_n ≅ G.iterate n for the recursively defined power comparison and C_(m,n) for the ordered composition of these comparisons [lem-zl-frobenius-power-return-commutation]. For natural numbers m,n and any equality h:(g^m).inv ; (g^n).inv=(g^(m+n)).inv, one has C_(m,n)=adicLowerStarComp ; adicLowerStarCongr(h) ; q_(m+n). This includes zero exponents.

source.place: Power-composition coherence in step 2 of the geometric orbit argument and the single-return transport square.

proof.text: Induct on n. At zero, naturality of q_0 and the right unit law for lowerStarFactor identify the two components. At a successor, naturality of the recursive powerStep gives the recursion for C_(m,n+1). Apply lowerStarFactor_assoc to the three inverse powers and cancel its two outer factorisation isomorphisms. The resulting equation is the same successor recursion for the geometric compositor. Apply the induction hypothesis and extensionality of natural isomorphisms. The factorisation identities lift from underlying sheaves to adic modules by Mod.hom_ext.

lean.statement:
theorem frobeniusPowerCompositionIso_geometric (m n : ℕ)
    (h : ((X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricGaloisFrobenius ^ m).inv ≫
      ((X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricGaloisFrobenius ^ n).inv =
      ((X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricGaloisFrobenius ^ (m + n)).inv) :
    frobeniusPowerCompositionIso (k₀ := k₀) (l := l) (X := X) m n =
      adicLowerStarComp l _ _ ≪≫ adicLowerStarCongr l h ≪≫
        frobeniusPowPullbackIterateIso (m + n)
